summary: Vireo Growth Inc. filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing that indirect subsidiaries entered a $60 million term loan with Needham Bank as of the October 2, 2026 closing date. The facility refinances and consolidates a $49 million seller promissory note held by Innovative Industrial Properties affiliate IIP-NY and an $11 million gap note secured by a gap mortgage on the Perth property. Interest is fixed at 8.50% per annum, calculated on a 360-day year, with joint and several borrower liability, and IIP-NY ceased to be a lender. The filing is a routine financing, not a special situation.
